newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: OAU wants Israel, Palestine to show restraint.
newsitem.headline: OAU wants Israel, Palestine to show restraint.

text.p: The Organisation of African Unity (OAU) on Saturday appealed to Israeli and Palestinian authorities to exercise restraint and end the violence that has claimed dozens of lives in the last few days.

The OAU said in a statement at its headquarters in Addis Ababa that it was following developments in the West Bank, Gaza and Jerusalem involving clashes between Israeli security forces and Palestinians with grave concern.

"The OAU which has been supportive of Middle East peace deeply regrets that this present outbreak of violence might further complicate an already difficult situation in the implementation of the peace process," the statement said.
The OAU called particularly on Israeli authorities to respect their obligations in conformity with existing agreements and to refrain from "exacerbating tension".
